sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/james-kipp-campground ('There are 34 sites that can accommodate trailers or recreational vehicles (RVs) up to 40 feet in length.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: RV waste dump ($10 fee); its water comes on after the last spring freeze, typically by May 15. 'The potable water system is currently shut down' (October 2026). Trash dumpsters; fire ring and picnic table at each site; boat launch.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/james-kipp-campground ('The potable water system is currently shut down. Water for the RV dump will become operational after the last spring freeze, typically by May 15.', 'The campground is equipped with vault toilets, trash dumpsters, and an RV waste dump ($10 dump fee).'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/james-kipp-campground ('Campsites are on a first-come, first-serve basis — NO RESERVATIONS'; Fees: '$20.00 per night, 14 Day stay limit') + recreation.gov search (facility 262717 James Kipp Campground, reservable false), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/james-kipp-campground ('James Kipp Recreation Area is situated along the Upper Missouri River and is open from April 1 to December 1, annually.'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM (Lewistown Field Office) campground in the Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument at the Fred Robinson Bridge (US-191) on the Missouri River; popular boat launch. --Claude
summary: BLM page: confirmed 34 FCFS sites for RVs to 40 ft, no hookups, vault toilets, RV dump, no reservations (derived values now verified) and the $20/night fee already recorded; added the 14-day stay limit and the season April 1 - December 1. Potable water is currently shut down (facilities note). Note: dropped the wrong '$12/night' and the restated sites/hookups/FCFS/season.
